glossary.AI: Tag: A mech can only have one system with this tag installed at a time.
glossary.Accuracy: Bonus d6s on attacks and checks; the highest one is added. Cancels Difficulty one for one.
glossary.Accurate: Tag: Attacks made with this weapon receive +X Accuracy.
glossary.Active: Status word; agrees with its referent. Keep consistent within a locale
glossary.Agility: From H/A/S/E: AGILITY describes a pilot's ability to build and pilot fast, evasive mechs. Contributes to final Evasion and Speed scores.
glossary.Archaic: Tag: This weapon is old-fashioned and can’t harm mechs.
glossary.Arcing: Tag: This weapon can be fired over obstacles, usually by lobbing a projectile in an arc.
glossary.Armor-Piercing (AP): Tag: Damage dealt by this weapon ignores Armor.
glossary.Barrage: Action: Attack with two weapons, or attack with a single superheavy weapon.
glossary.Blast: Rules term: Equipment with a BLAST attack pattern affects characters within a radius of X spaces, drawn from a point within RANGE and line of sight.
glossary.Bond: A pilot's bond (from the Karrakin Trade Baronies), with bond powers and XP.
glossary.Bonus Damage: Rules term: Extra damage. kinetic, energy or explosive that is added onto melee or ranged attacks.
glossary.Boost: Action: Take an extra movement of at least 1 space, up to your SPEED.
glossary.Boot Up: Action: Fire up your mech from Shut Down.
glossary.Brace: Action: Brace your mech for impact, reducing damage at the cost of your next turn’s actions.
glossary.Burn: Damage type and status: ongoing damage at the end of each turn until a Systems save clears it. A noun, not the verb "to burn".
glossary.Burst: Rules term: Equipment with a BURST attack pattern affects characters within a radius of X spaces, centered on and including the space occupied by the user (or target).
glossary.COMP/CON: App full name; should align with Mech System "COMP/CON"
glossary.Cascade: An AI going rogue ("in cascade"): it stops following its pilot.
glossary.Character: Rules term: A player character (PC), non-player character, (NPC), or any other entity capable of acting (or reacting) independently, such as DRONES.
glossary.Condition: A harmful status (Exposed, Stunned, ...). The UI also uses "Condition" for a SITREP victory condition; that is a different key.
glossary.Cone: Rules term: Equipment with a CONE attack pattern affects characters within a cone X spaces long and X spaces wide at its furthest point.
glossary.Core Bonus: A permanent pilot upgrade linked to a manufacturer. Pilots select a Core Bonus every three License Levels, on level-up.
glossary.Core Power: The once-per-mission resource that activates a Core System.
glossary.Core System: A frame's unique signature system, powered by Core Power.
glossary.Cover: Terrain: soft or hard cover that gives Difficulty to attacks.
glossary.Critical Hit: Rules term: A 20+ on a melee or ranged attack causes a critical hit.
glossary.Damage: Rules term: Damage taken is subtracted from HP, and is either kinetic, explosive, energy, or burn.
glossary.Danger Zone: Status or condition: Heat level at half capacity or more.
glossary.Dangerous Terrain: Rules term: When characters end their turn in dangerous terrain or move into it for the first time in a round, they must make an ENGINEERING check.
glossary.Deployable: Tag: This system is an object that can be deployed on the field.
glossary.Difficult Terrain: Rules term: All movement through difficult terrain is at half speed. each space of difficult terrain they move into is equivalent to two spaces of movement.
glossary.Difficulty: Penalty d6s on attacks and checks; the highest one is subtracted. Cancels Accuracy one for one.
glossary.Disengage: Action: Disengage safely from a dangerous situation.
glossary.Dismount: Action: Get out of your mech.
glossary.Down and Out: Status or condition: Pilot is unconscious, any additional damage kills.
glossary.Downtime: Time between missions, spent on downtime actions and projects.
glossary.Drone: Tag: This is a self-propelled, semi-autonomous unit with rudimentary intelligence.
glossary.E-Defense: Rules term: E-DEFENSE is how hard it is for electronic and guided weapons and systems to hit you.
glossary.Eidolon: A class of horror enemy made of layers and shards.
glossary.Eject: Action: Eject from your mech, flying 6 spaces in the direction of your choice.
glossary.Engaged: Status or condition: Ranged attacks made by an this character receive +1 difficulty. All additional movement is lost if ENGAGED by a target of equal or greater SIZE.
glossary.Engineering: From H/A/S/E: ENGINEERING skill describes a pilot's ability to build and pilot mechs with powerful reactors, supplies and support systems. Contributes to Heat Capacity and Limited Systems Bonus final values.
glossary.Exotic Gear: Tag: EXOTIC GEAR is a general tag for equipment that exists outside the traditional licensing system.
glossary.Exposed: Status or condition: All kinetic, explosive, or energy damage taken by this character is doubled.
glossary.Fall Damage: Rules term: Unless specified otherwise, characters start to fall at the end of the current turn, and fall at the end of each of their turns thereafter.
glossary.Fight: Action: Attack with one weapon as a pilot.
glossary.Flight: Rules term: Flying characters can move vertically and horizontally up to their SPEED.
glossary.Fragment Signal: Action: IMPAIR and SLOW a character until the end of their next turn.
glossary.Frame: Mech chassis model, linked to a Manufacturer.
glossary.Free: Activation type: Free Action (costs no action). Not "free" as in no charge.
glossary.Free Action: Tag: Characters can take free actions at any point during their turn, and they don’t count toward the number of quick or full actions they take.
glossary.Full: Activation type: Full Action. Not "full" as in no space left.
glossary.Full Action: Tag: This system requires a full action to Activate.
glossary.Full Activation: Action: Activate a system or piece of gear that uses a full action.
glossary.Full Tech: Tag: This tech can be used as a Full Tech Action
glossary.GMS: Manufacturer acronyms must remain as-is (key usage)
glossary.Gear: Tag: This is a tool, piece of equipment, or another item.
glossary.Grapple: Action: Attempt to grab on your target, potentially immobilizing it or riding it.
glossary.Grenade: Tag: As a quick action, this explosive or other device can be thrown to a space within line of sight and the specified Range.
glossary.Grit: Pilot combat bonus derived from License Level
glossary.HA: Manufacturer acronyms must remain as-is (key usage)
glossary.HP: Rules term: The amount of damage a pilot can receive before going DOWN AND OUT, and the amount of damage a mech can receive before it takes structure damage.
glossary.Heat: Mech heat tracked stat, takes Heat-typed damage, maximum set by Heat Capacity stat.
glossary.Heat (Self): Tag: Immediately after using this weapon or system, the user takes X Heat.
glossary.Heat Capacity: Rules term: Your mech can take heat from tech attacks and some of its own systems.
glossary.Heavy: Weapon size, and the mount type that holds it.
glossary.Hidden: Status or condition: This character can’t be targeted by hostile attacks or actions, doesn't cause engagement, and enemies only know their approximate location.
glossary.Hide: Game action (Quick Action): become Hidden. The UI also has a "Hide" button; that is a different key.
glossary.Hover: Rules term: a flying character that stays in place without moving.
glossary.Hull: From H/A/S/E: HULL skill describes a pilot's ability to build and pilot durable, heavy mechs that can take punches and keep going. Contributes to Mech HP and Repair Capacity final values.
glossary.IPS-N: Manufacturer acronyms must remain as-is (key usage)
glossary.Immobilized: Status or condition: IMMOBILIZED characters cannot make any voluntary movements.
glossary.Immunity: Rules term: Characters with IMMUNITY ignore all damage and effects from whatever they are immune to.
glossary.Impaired: Status or condition: IMPAIRED characters receive +1 difficulty on all attacks, saves, and skill checks.
glossary.Improvised Attack: Action: Attack with a fist, rifle butt, or improvised weapon in melee.
glossary.Inaccurate: Tag: Attacks made with this weapon receive +X Difficulty.
glossary.Indestructible: Tag: This equipment cannot be marked as Destroyed
glossary.Integrated: Built into the frame: an integrated mount or integrated system.
glossary.Invade: Tag: This system provides additional options for the Invade Quick Tech Action.
glossary.Invisible: Status or condition: All attacks against INVISIBLE characters have a 50 percent chance to miss before an attack roll is made. INVISIBLE characters can always HIDE, even without cover.
glossary.Involuntary Movement: Rules term: When characters are pushed, pulled, or knocked in certain directions, it is called involuntary movement.
glossary.Invulnerable: Tag: This equipment is immune to all damage.
glossary.Irreducible: Tag: Prohibits damage reduction from any source (HIDDEN TAG)
glossary.Jammed: Status or condition: JAMMED characters can’t use comms, make attacks other than IMPROVISED ATTACK, GRAPPLE, and RAM, take reactions, or take or benefit from tech actions.
glossary.Jockey: Action: Attempt to attack a mech on foot as a pilot.
glossary.Knockback: Tag: On a hit, the user may choose to knock their target X spaces in a straight line directly away from the point of origin (e.g., the attacking mech or the center of a Blast).
glossary.Layer: One phase of an Eidolon, with its own stats and abilities.
glossary.License: Unlocks a manufacturer's frame and gear by level
glossary.License Level: Pilot rank (LL0-LL12); each level grants a license rank, talent rank or core bonus.
glossary.Limited: Tag: This weapon or system can only be used X times before it requires a Full Repair.
glossary.Limited Systems Bonus: Extra uses for Limited systems, from Engineering.
glossary.Line: Rules term: Equipment with a LINE attack pattern affects all targets within a straight line, X spaces long.
glossary.Loading: Tag: This weapon must be reloaded after each use.
glossary.Loading (Multiple Uses): Tag: This weapon must be reloaded after X uses.
glossary.Lock On: Status or condition: Hostile characters can consume LOCK ON for +1 accuracy on their next attack against this character.
glossary.Main: Weapon size, and the mount type that holds it.
glossary.Mech: The combat machine a Pilot deploys
glossary.Mine: Tag: As a quick action, this device can be planted in an adjacent, free and valid space on any surface, but not adjacent to any other mines.
glossary.Mod: Mech Equipment or NPC Feature; these are systems/features that modify either a Mech Weapon (PC) or another NPC Feature (NPC)
glossary.Modded: Tag: This weapon has been equipped with a weapon mod.
glossary.Mount: A weapon mount slot on a Frame (noun). Not the verb 'to mount', distinct from the pilot Mount action.
glossary.Move: Action: Move your character up to its Speed in any direction.
glossary.NPC: Non-player character, run by the GM.
glossary.None: Status / empty-value word. Translate per context - do not assume one form
glossary.Ordnance: Tag: This weapon can only be fired before the user moves or takes any other actions on their turn, excepting Protocols.
glossary.Overcharge: Combat action; spend heat for an additional quick action
glossary.Overheating: Taking stress from exceeding Heat Capacity; triggers an overheating check.
glossary.Overkill: Tag: When rolling for damage with this weapon, any damage dice that land on a X cause the attacker to take 1 Heat, and are then rerolled.
glossary.Overshield: Tag: This system provides HP that disappears at the end of the scene or when a specified condition is met.
glossary.Overwatch: Action: Attack a close-by target attempting to move.
glossary.Pending: Status word; agrees with its referent
glossary.Personal Armor: Tag: This gear offers protection in combat, but it is obvious to observers and usually can’t be hidden.
glossary.Pilot: A character the player controls; a PC within the context of the world: someone who pilots a Mech
glossary.Pilot Gear: Personal equipment carried by a pilot (armor, weapons, gear).
glossary.Pilot Group: A named group of pilots in the roster.
glossary.Pilot Weapon: Tag: On missions, pilots can take up to two weapons.
glossary.Prepare: Action: Ready a quick action for a specified trigger.
glossary.Prevent Cascade: Tag: Prohibits an AI system from being recognized as a valid target for Cascading (HIDDEN TAG)
glossary.Prone: Status or condition: Attacks against PRONE targets receive +1 accuracy. PRONE characters are SLOWED and count as moving in difficult terrain.
glossary.Protocol: Tag: This system can be activated as a free action, but only at the start of the user’s turn.
glossary.Quick Action: Tag: This system requires a quick action to Activate.
glossary.Quick Activation: Action: Activate a system or piece of gear that uses a quick action.
glossary.Quick Tech: Tag: This tech can be used as a Quick Tech Action
glossary.Ram: Action: Attempt to knock down or knock back your target.
glossary.Range: Range pattern and weapon stat: how far an attack reaches, in spaces.
glossary.Reaction: Tag: This system can be activated as a reaction.
glossary.Reactor Meltdown: Catastrophic reactor failure that destroys the mech after a delay.
glossary.Recharge: Tag: Once this system or weapon has been used, it can’t be used again until it is recharged.
glossary.Reliable: Tag: This weapon has some degree of self-correction or is simply powerful enough to cause damage even with a glancing blow.
glossary.Reload: Action: Reload one weapon as a pilot.
glossary.Repair Capacity: Rules term: REPAIRS are a kind of currency that you can use to heal and repair your mech.
glossary.Reserve: A mission-usable resource a Pilot banks through Downtime Actions or GM fiat
glossary.Resistance: Rules term: Characters with RESISTANCE reduce damage, heat, or a type of damage, by half, after ARMOR has been applied.
glossary.Resistance (All): Tag: This unit has Resistance to all damage types
glossary.Roll: Game term for a dice roll. The UI has separate keys for the noun (a roll) and the verb (to roll).
glossary.SITREP: Situation report: the mission type and victory conditions of an encounter.
glossary.SP: Game stat: system points, the budget for installing mech systems.
glossary.SSC: Manufacturer acronyms must remain as-is (key usage)
glossary.Save: As in SAVE TARGET. Do not use the disk-Save word here; this is the stat. Keep distinct from the Save (store) action
glossary.Save Target: Rules term: When you force another character to make a save, they must match or beat your mech’s SAVE TARGET or take consequences.
glossary.Scan: Action: Perform a deep scan on an enemy
glossary.Search: Game action (Quick Action): look for Hidden characters. The UI also has a "Search" field; that is a different key.
glossary.Seeking: Tag: This weapon has a limited form of self-guidance and internal propulsion, allowing it to follow complicated paths to its targets.
glossary.Self Destruct: Action: As a last ditch measure, set your reactor to go critical and explode.
glossary.Sensors: Detection range stat, as in "Sensor Range"
glossary.Shard: A piece of an Eidolon that can be destroyed separately.
glossary.Shield: Tag: This system is an energy shield of some kind.
glossary.Shredded: Status or condition: SHREDDED characters don’t benefit from ARMOR or RESISTANCE.
glossary.Shut Down: Status or condition: While SHUT DOWN, mechs are STUNNED indefinitely.
glossary.Sidearm: Tag: This weapon can be used to Fight as a quick action instead of a full action.
glossary.Size: Combat actor size stat, 0.5 - 4 (for Mechs). Distinct from non-game app usage (eg. file size)
glossary.Skill Check: Action: Perform an activity with a clear goal that would take a skill check.
glossary.Skill Trigger: A Pilot skill used for checks. Keep one agreed term per language. Keep distinct from a Reaction's "trigger"
glossary.Skirmish: Action: Attack with a single weapon.
glossary.Slowed: Status or condition: This character can’t BOOST or make any special moves granted by talents, systems, or weapons.
glossary.Smart: Tag: This weapon has self-guidance systems, self-propelled projectiles, or even nanorobotic ammunition.
glossary.Stabilize: Action: Heal and cool down your mech, reload, or attempt to end conditions affecting it.
glossary.Stress: Reactor stress, the stat that is reduced when Heat Capacity is maxed. When a Mech reaches zero Stress it (and its reactor) is destroyed.
glossary.Structure: Mech structure value; reduced when HP reaches zero. When a mech loses all Structure points it is destroyed
glossary.Structure Damage: Damage that removes a point of Structure and triggers a structure check.
glossary.Stunned: Status or condition: STUNNED mechs cannot OVERCHARGE, move, or take any actions.
glossary.Superheavy: Weapon size that needs a heavy mount plus one additional mount.
glossary.System: Mech equipment that occupies system points
glossary.System Points: Rules term: Mech FRAMES also have a set number of SYSTEM POINTS (SP).
glossary.Systems: From H/A/S/E: The "SYSTEMS" score that describes a pilot's ability to build and pilot technical mechs with powerful electronic warfare tools. Influences E-Defense, Tech Attack, and System Points final values. **NOT the plural of Mech Equipment "System"**
glossary.Talent: Pilot ability that confers bonuses/actions/equipment/etc. Has three ranks, is selected or upgraded on character creation and level-up.
glossary.Tech Attack: Rules term: You add your mech’s TECH ATTACK as a bonus instead of GRIT when you conduct electronic warfare
glossary.TechAtk: Abbreviation of Tech Attack, used where space is short.
glossary.Teleport: Rules term: Characters must start and end a teleport on a surface they can normally move on; for example, a character that can’t fly can’t teleport mid-air.
glossary.Template: An NPC template that modifies an NPC class (Elite, Grunt, Ultra, ...).
glossary.Threat: Rules term: The maximum range at which melee and overwatch attacks can be made with certain weapons, measured from the attacking character.
glossary.Thrown: Tag: This melee weapon can be thrown at targets within X spaces.
glossary.Unique: Tag: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated. each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.
glossary.Unlimited: Tag: This ability can be used any number of times per round.
glossary.Weapon: Mech, Pilot, or NPC armament. Equipment/Feature that makes attack actions.
glossary.Zero Gravity: Rules term: Mechs operating underwater, in zero-g, or in space are SLOWED unless they have a propulsion or flight system; however, they can’t fall and can fly when moving regardless of whether they have a flight system.

ui.active.common.saveFailed: The failure state of a data-save operation, not eg. a failed saving throw
ui.active.common.saveSuccessful: Used here only to refer to the success state of a data-save operation, not eg. the result of a saving throw
ui.active.sheetItem.started: Refers to sheet/encounter launched timestamp. "Created" in other cases , but this refers to specifically when the user started using this sheet
ui.active.telemetry.lifetime: Refers to the entire "career" of the Pilot, which is to say the sum of all telemetry records of pilot data between encounters/missions
ui.classes.newDoodad: "Doodad" refers to a non-actor combat encounter trackable, like terrain. New to v3.
ui.classes.newEnvironment: A new, user-defined instance of the environment aspect of an Encounter (Holy World, Low Gravity Environment, etc)
ui.classes.newEnvironmentDescription: The placeholder text that appears when a user creates a new encounter environment preset
ui.common.background: The Pilot field (Celebrity, Worker, Supersoldier, etc)
ui.common.bonus: C/C-specific term for additional stats/abilities/other game logic applied to an item or equipment, eg Neurolink gives a +3 range Bonus
ui.common.changelog: Term for the developer/author-created list of changes between app, LCP, or collection releases
ui.common.convert: Used as a short form for "Convert to local data"
ui.common.created: Used as a label for the timestamp set at the creation of data
ui.common.deployment: GM instructions for initial PC/NPC setup in an Encounter. eg DEPLOYMENT: PCs start on the east side of the map, in any space touching the edge of the map
ui.common.environment: The non-SITREP component of an Encounter -- eg "Holy World", "Low Gravity Environment"
ui.common.hidden: Used only for UI here (eg. "4 Items Hidden" after a filter is applied). The Status is included in Compendium data)
ui.common.loadout: Refers to the collection of items/equipment/features that are assigned to a given Pilot, Mech, or NPC
ui.common.noData: UI string used when items are missing or haven't been created; when a view can't render due to no content
ui.common.pilotBonds: Referred to as "Bonds" in KTB, C/C uses "Pilot Bonds" for clarity in English (may not be required in all cases)
ui.common.rank: Rank as in level or standing, refers to the level of an ranked item like a Pilot Talent, eg. Bonded Rank II grants Intercede
ui.common.search: The UI action (eg "search the Compendium). The search game action is included in Compendium data
ui.common.shareCode: Code used to transmit pilot/npc/etc data in-app
ui.common.sitrep: English capitals are intentional here, and should not be rendered in other cases (if the option exists, ie no "Sitreps"). Short form of "SITUATION REPORT"
ui.common.statsLabel: Shortened form of "Statistics", used for static or trackable game values like HP, Reactor Stress, and so forth
ui.common.status: UI; used to denote situation or state of data (eg "pending sync") or, in the case of pilots, active/inactive/KIA/etc. Not the game rules status/conditions label
ui.common.tables: Refers to "Rollable Tables" here - roll (usually) 1d20 and get a result. Structure and Stress damage tables are examples. Can be user-defined.
ui.common.tier: Used for both NPC level (T1/2/3) and Patreon subscription level. If necessary these can be split out.
ui.common.tierN: Used here only to refer to NPC Tier
ui.common.trigger: Used for the Reaction initial condition here (TRIGGER: an ally within range 5 takes damage), and not the "Skill Trigger" Pilot narrative ability
ui.compendium.campaign.recommendedPlayers: Refers to the number of recommended players in a campaign, eg. 2-4 PCs
ui.gm.campaign.major: Refers to version number, as in "major.minor.patch"
ui.gm.campaign.minor: Refers to version number, as in "major.minor.patch"
ui.gm.campaign.patch: The smallest element of an x.y.z version number -- major.minor.patch
ui.mainMenu.collection.addCollectionItem: Used to prompt a collection author to add a shareable item to a collection
ui.mainMenu.ui.upgrade: Used to direct user to Patreon membership page
ui.nav.log.caller: Used in the options menu error log to refer to the component/class/block of code from which the error originates. The "calling function".  Clarity/intuitiveness over exactness of translation is recommended here.
ui.nav.storage.neverAutoDeleteFull: `{never}` in this case will always refer to a translated "never" string, wrapped in this way to satisfy a v-safe-html check internally
ui.pm.shared.nb: Part of pilot creation/level up flavor text. Short form of latin "nota bene" ("note well"), used to signify "take note" or "the following is important"
ui.pm.shared.warningSubmission: Ambiguous plural is intentional here; should comport to formal legal/military register
